contracts: LP_FAST mux0 uses the actual powered/tuned RC oscillator17.5MHz in this virtual profile, mux1 is XTAL/2=24MHz, mux2 XTAL48MHz. HP FOSC bridge gate cannot remove the independent LP oscillator.
Bus settles watchdogs under the old fast source before publishing a changed observation. Pending reset blocks normal clock mutation/publication.

SWD feed pulses retain a240MHz-scaled remaining numerator across frequency changes and loss; missing source pauses only pulse progress. Analog request850ms/expiry950ms stay fixed204M/228M nominal cycles; RWDT and LP_TIMER keep their separate slow source.

CPU/Core retention and LP controller reset preserve external observations in the module. The reset owner publishes a reset LP mux at reset_at before late catch-up. Analog reset restores the declared default24MHz source.

Same-cycle analog expiry wins over pulse completion or a new source. Pending/dispatched reset barriers cannot be advanced or withdrawn by a changed source. Arithmetic catch-up is bounded independently of elapsed time.

earlyDiagnosticScope.reason: A bounded prefix before SWD request/pulse engagement isolated the mux before pulse integration. requests/feeds/pulse were all0. It is not dynamic-SWD proof.

negativeResults.reason: A new source-loss fixture tried restoring FOSC DFREQ172 after100; this lies outside the declared retuning subset and was correctly rejected.
negativeResults.correction: Use the already modeled actual FOSC power30 control to withdraw and restore the oscillator. Pulse/phase and reset assertions are retained; no production code was loosened.

negativeResults.reason: Source audit corrected an initial informal48MHz interpretation: LP word0 selects RC_FAST, not XTAL. Fixed headers and actual guest a0=0 govern the implementation.

independentModuleReview.scope: Final LP_WDT source, unchanged RWDT helper and original28-test body. No independent Bus/SoC, full-suite or original-factory execution claimed.

limits: Functional awake LP_DYN_FAST equals LP_FAST; sleep switching remains unsupported.
Virtual oscillator rates and analog SWD age are explicit inputs, not physical calibration or pulse-timing accuracy.
This real factory prefix has not requested a SWD feed. Dynamic pulse correctness is tested by actual module and MMIO fixtures, not inferred from the native boot log.
Focused LTO=false checks do not replace final default-LTO CI, CPU controls, production WASM/browser or app_main/LCD/buttons/TF acceptance. No C5 publication claimed.
curation: Commands, source/input/log hashes and numeric results retained. Raw captures remain ignored; personal paths and process/session inventories are omitted without altering measured values.
